subject: Finalizing purchasing terms and invoice schedule for Redwood deployment
content:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@evergreenhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0500
Subject: Finalizing purchasing terms and invoice schedule for Redwood deployment

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for the productive call earlier. Quick follow-up so we can get procurement paperwork moving on both sides. A couple of questions from Evergreen's checklist we need to confirm before activation:

- Do you require a formal signed PO referencing the statement of work (SOW) before Redwood turns up capacity?
- What net terms does Evergreen require (net30, net45, net60)? Do you have a preferred starting cadence for new vendors?
- Invoice cadence: do you need monthly invoices in arrears, milestone invoices, or a split invoice per business unit?
- Any specific PO fields we should populate (GL code, cost center, tax ID, billing contact)?

We typically invoice monthly in arrears and can work with net30 for enterprise customers; for very large commits we can discuss upfront allocation or staggered billing. I can share a SOW and our billing contact once we agree on the PO and terms.

I'll loop Marcus (revenue ops) and Laura (account lead) to confirm internal billing setup.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0127

---

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@evergreenhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@evergreenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Finalizing purchasing terms and invoice schedule for Redwood deployment

Neha —

Thanks for the summary. A few procurement constraints on our side:

- Evergreen requires a fully executed PO before we provision vendor services. The PO must reference the SOW and include our internal PO number field.
- Standard is net30, but finance has been moving some initial vendor contracts to net45 for new suppliers; if possible, please indicate whether Redwood can accept net45 for the first 60 days, then move to net30.
- Invoice cadence: we prefer monthly invoices in arrears. For omnibus projects that span multiple Evergreen entities, we request either a single consolidated invoice with a project-level breakdown or split invoices per legal entity (we can provide GL codes).
- We will need Redwood's W-9, remit-to address, and the name/email of your AP contact.

Attached is our PO template (Evergreen_PO_template_v3.pdf). If Redwood needs a different format, send us a draft and we'll try to align it with our system. Also attaching our vendor onboarding questionnaire (vendor_onboarding_questionnaire.xlsx).

Oliver Grant
Procurement Manager — Evergreen Health Systems
oliver.grant@evergreenhealth.com

---

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@evergreenhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Finalizing purchasing terms and invoice schedule for Redwood deployment

Appreciate the clarity, Oliver. Quick responses and two options to keep things moving while we align finance teams:

Option A (preferred): Redwood accepts net30. We will invoice monthly in arrears with a single consolidated invoice that includes a line-item breakdown by project and legal entity. We can populate GL/cost center fields if you provide the codes.

Option B (alternate): Redwood can accept net45 for the initial 60-day onboarding window if Evergreen is able to provide a PO that references the SOW and confirms the invoice cadence. For commercial predictability, if net45 is required we would request either a small onboarding allocation (10% of month 1) or agree on a credit-check/finance approval to keep pricing intact.

Next steps from our side: I attached the draft SOW (Redwood_SOW_Q1.pdf) — please review and let us know which option you prefer. Once we have a signed PO we will provide our W-9 and formal AP contact (ap-billing@redwood.com).

CC'ing Marcus to confirm any internal billing constraints.

Thanks,
Neha

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Finalizing purchasing terms and invoice schedule for Redwood deployment

Neha —

Quick internal note on finance tolerance: Connor and I discussed Evergreen's ask. We can generally accept net30 for enterprise accounts if one of the following is true:
- Total committed spend (first 12 months) is > $50k, OR
- We receive an approved credit form and signed PO in advance, OR
- The customer provides a 10% initial allocation (applied to first invoice)

Splitting invoices per legal entity increases AP overhead; if Evergreen can accept a consolidated invoice with per-entity line items (GL codes included), that's the path of least friction. Connor — can you confirm whether finance would allow a one-time net45 exception if Evergreen needs it for their internal approvals?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

---

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0500
Subject: RE: Finalizing purchasing terms and invoice schedule for Redwood deployment

Marcus/Neha —

We can make a one-time net45 exception for onboarding if the PO is signed and the total ARR commit is >= $50k. Otherwise finance prefers net30; for smaller deals we'll ask for upfront allocation or a credit application. When you send the SOW/PO I'll run the vendor check and push for net30 where possible.

Connor O'Brien
Finance — Redwood Inference

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@evergreenhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@evergreenhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 14:42:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Finalizing purchasing terms and invoice schedule for Redwood deployment

Neha/Team —

Thanks for the options and internal review. Evergreen is comfortable with the following approach:

- We will issue a signed PO that references the provided SOW. PO will specify net30.
- Invoice cadence will be monthly in arrears. Please include per-project line items and our requested GL codes (see attachment).
- Attached is our signed PO (Evergreen_PO_signed_0218.pdf). We will upload it to our vendor system once you confirm Redwood's remit and W-9.
- For onboarding, we will run your vendor questionnaire and expect to have vendor onboarding completed within 5 business days.

I attached the signed PO and the onboarding questionnaire (completed by our team). Let me know the best email to route invoices to; Sarah (cc'd) is our billing coordinator.

Oliver Grant
Procurement Manager — Evergreen Health Systems

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@evergreenhealth.com>, Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@evergreenhealth.com>

Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 11:22:00 -0500
Subject: RE: Finalizing purchasing terms and invoice schedule for Redwood deployment

Oliver / Sarah —

Great — thanks for the signed PO. A quick checklist and next steps:

- We have the signed PO (Evergreen_PO_signed_0218.pdf) and the onboarding questionnaire.
- Redwood will accept net30 and will invoice monthly in arrears. We will include per-project line items and the GL codes provided.
- Please send invoices to: ap-billing@redwood.com (we will also add evergreen-billing@evergreenhealth.com for visibility).
- We will provide our W-9 and remit-to address in a separate secure email and upload the SOW to DocuSign for signature.
- Onboarding call: I scheduled a 30-minute kickoff for Tue Mar 3, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET (invite sent).

Attachments sent: Redwood_SOW_Q1.pdf, Evergreen_PO_signed_0218.pdf.

If anything changes on your side (split invoices vs consolidated), please flag before the first invoice period. Otherwise we'll proceed to provisioning once we have the final signed DocuSign SOW and the PO in your system.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
